adjacent_relevant_theorem.citation: J. Distler, S. Garibaldi, 'There is no Theory of Everything inside E8', Comm. Math. Phys. 298 (2010) 419, arXiv:0905.2658
adjacent_relevant_theorem.claim: No embedding of the Standard Model gauge group and gravity into a single real or complex form of E8's adjoint representation can carry three chiral fermion generations, by a dimension bound on the -1-eigenspace of a central Spin(3,1) element (<=128-dim available vs >=~192 needed)
adjacent_relevant_theorem.relevance: downstream risk if R8's gap is later closed and generations are then embedded in a single E8 adjoint copy -- does not itself forbid constructing E8 from octonions+J3(O)
adjacent_relevant_theorem.already_flagged_in_project: docs/PHASE_R_HYPOTHESIS_BACKLOG.md, cited as the no-go behind 'Priority 0'

task5_smallest_extension: Adjoin the exceptional Jordan algebra J3(O) (3x3 Hermitian octonionic matrices, Jordan product) to Phase A1's existing octonions. Everything else in the magic square follows mechanically.
verdict_text: Additional mathematics is required, and it has been identified exactly: the exceptional Jordan algebra J3(O). Not previously attempted (correctly flagged but not pursued in docs/PHASE_R_HYPOTHESIS_BACKLOG.md item 9). No known impossibility theorem blocks this specific lift.
